title: PluginCatalog
description: Machine-global, persistent plugin catalog (plugin_catalog_get / plugin_catalog_update): the scan cache plus user curation (favorites/recents/tags/pinned params). Lives at dirs::config_dir()/aura/plugin-catalog.json — NOT project state, one file per machine. Emitter contract: readers must tolerate unknown fields (D-06 discipline — deliberately no additionalProperties:false).

version.description: Schema version. A file with any other version is treated as absent (empty catalog) rather than migrated.

scannedAt.description: Unix seconds of the last successful plugin_scan. Absent before AURA has ever scanned on this machine.

path.description: Bundle file this descriptor was read from (CLAP); empty string for LV2, which has no single stat-able bundle file.

mtime.description: Bundle modification time, unix seconds. 0 for LV2.

size.description: Bundle size in bytes. 0 for LV2.

recents.description: Most-recently-used first; capped at 40 and de-duplicated by uid (a re-use moves the existing entry to the front).

pinnedParams.description: uid -> pinned param ids, capped at 8 per uid.
